in_marathi.name: Shashvansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shashvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shashvansh means one who carries on the legacy of prosperity. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shash', which means 'prosperity' and 'Vansh', which means 'legacy'.
